description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and functions related to the TorchScript interpreter runtime, including Code management, InterpreterState, and tensor context functions. It contains declarations for executing and managing TorchScript graphs in C++.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Represents compiled TorchScript code, managing instructions, graph, and associated metadata.

classes.name: MobileCode
classes.description: A specialized subclass of Code optimized for mobile deployment.

classes.name: InterpreterState
classes.description: Handles the runtime execution state for TorchScript code, including running code asynchronously.

classes.name: Suspend
classes.description: Exception class used to signal suspension during interpretation.

classes.name: InterpreterContinuation
classes.description: Manages the continuation state during interpreter execution, including handling of distributed autograd context.
